sentences.en: Historical distinctions also remain between central highlanders and coastal people.
sentences.zh: 历史上的区别仍然存在于中部高地人和沿海居民之间。

sentences.en: Years later, Europeans established colonies in the coastal areas.
sentences.zh: 多年后，欧洲人在沿海地区建立了殖民地。

sentences.en: The coastal ecosystem of British Columbia is rapidly declining.
sentences.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚的海岸生态系统正在迅速衰退。
